title: Conlang Lexicon and Examples JSON Schema
description: Draft 7 schema for row-oriented JSON representations of LEXICON.tsv and EXAMPLES.tsv. Convert TSV rows to JSON objects before validation. This schema is designed to be TEI-compatible. Properties map to standard TEI elements; conversion via XSLT or programmatic transformation should be straightforward. The schema enforces field presence, controlled vocabularies, identifier syntax, IPA character inventory, and conditional lexical derivation rules. Cross-row uniqueness, cross-file references, grammar-section existence, segmentation/gloss token-count alignment, predictable-inflection detection, semantic restrictions, and ID immutability across repository history require validation code outside JSON Schema draft 7.

teiMapping.description: Documentation-only mapping from JSON/TSV properties to TEI P5 dictionary and text structures. This metadata does not affect JSON Schema validation.

id.description: Use the stable lexical entry identifier as the TEI xml:id on the entry element, for example <entry xml:id="L-0001">.

form.description: Map the lexical form to the TEI form element, typically using <orth> inside <form>.

ipa.description: Map the phonemic transcription to TEI pron, normally under the appropriate form/pronunciation structure.

pos.description: Map the part-of-speech value to pos inside a grammatical group.

gloss.description: Map the English lexical gloss to gloss within the relevant sense element.

type.description: Preserve the lexical classification as a typed note when it is not represented by a more specific TEI structural element.

derived_from.description: Map a lexical parent or parent list to etym when an etymological analysis is appropriate; otherwise preserve it in a typed note. Multiple semicolon-separated parents should become multiple references.

status.description: Preserve the development/status value as a typed note so established, analyzed, experimental, unresolved, deprecated, and legacy stable states are not lost during conversion.

notes.description: Map free-text annotations to TEI note elements, preserving provenance and analytical qualifications.

id.description: Use the stable example identifier as xml:id on the TEI example or containing element.

text.description: Map the conlang example text to quote with xml:lang="conlang".

ipa.description: Map the phonemic transcription to pron associated with the quoted example.

translation.description: Map the English translation to quote with xml:lang="en".

segmentation.description: Map word-level segmentation to w elements and represent morpheme boundaries with nested or adjacent TEI markup appropriate to the conversion workflow.

gloss.description: Map the aligned grammatical gloss to a grammatical group, retaining Leipzig-style labels and alignment with segmented morphemes.

grammar_refs.description: Convert each semicolon-separated grammar reference to a TEI ref whose target resolves to a section identifier in GRAMMAR.md.

entry_refs.description: Convert each semicolon-separated lexical ID to a TEI ref targeting the corresponding lexical entry xml:id.

status.description: Preserve the example development status as a typed note.

notes.description: Map provenance, uncertainty, testing notes, and other free-text annotations to TEI note.

ID.description: Stable identifier: alphanumeric segments separated by single hyphens. Existing L-/E- identifiers are retained.

IPA.description: Phonemic transcription using only the established segment inventory /a e i u p t k c m n s h w j r/ plus length marks : or ː. Optional slash delimiters are accepted. '?' is reserved for intentionally unresolved examples/data.

LEXICON.title: LEXICON.tsv single row
LEXICON.description: Schema for one lexical row after parsing the tab-separated file into a JSON object.

form.description: Orthographic form in established project orthography. This should represent a lexical form, not a merely predictable inflected form.

type.description: Lexical classification. 'lexeme' and 'pronoun' are retained because they occur in the current repository; compound supports multiple lexical parents when appropriate.

pos.description: Part-of-speech tag. Lowercase values are preferred; existing uppercase values and — are accepted for compatibility with the current repository.

derived_from.description: Immediate lexical parent. Use — when no parent applies, ? when unresolved, or one or more lexical IDs separated by semicolons for compounds.

status.description: Current development status. 'stable' is retained as a legacy repository value; 'established' is the preferred canonical term.

notes.description: Free-text annotations, including provenance, historical information, irregularities, or reasons for unresolved/deprecated analyses.

LEXICON.$comment: Cross-entry validity of derived_from, duplicate-ID detection, and ID immutability across repository history must be checked by the validation script. Compound parent lists are valid only for compound analyses.

EXAMPLES.title: EXAMPLES.tsv single row
EXAMPLES.description: Schema for one example row after parsing the tab-separated file into a JSON object.

text.description: Example sentence or utterance in established orthography. '?' is permitted as an explicit unresolved placeholder.

ipa.description: Phonemic transcription of the whole example. Word boundaries are represented by spaces; '?' is reserved for intentionally unresolved examples.

translation.description: English translation or whole-example gloss. '?' is permitted as an explicit unresolved placeholder.

segmentation.description: Morpheme-by-morpheme segmentation: hyphens within words, spaces between words. '?' is permitted as an explicit unresolved placeholder.

gloss.description: Leipzig-style grammatical gloss aligned with segmentation. '?' is permitted as an explicit unresolved placeholder.

grammar_refs.description: Optional semicolon-separated references to documented sections in GRAMMAR.md; validation code must verify resolution.

entry_refs.description: Optional semicolon-separated lexical IDs; validation code must verify each ID exists in LEXICON.tsv.

status.description: Current development status. 'stable' is retained as a legacy repository value; 'established' is preferred.

notes.description: Optional provenance, ambiguity, testing, or analysis notes.

EXAMPLES.$comment: JSON Schema cannot compare segmentation/gloss token counts, verify reference existence, or determine whether an experimental example supports an established rule. Validation code must enforce those cross-field and cross-file conditions.

LEXICON_ARRAY.title: LEXICON.tsv file as an array
LEXICON_ARRAY.description: Array schema for a complete parsed LEXICON.tsv file. Each item is one lexical row.
LEXICON_ARRAY.$comment: Draft 7 cannot directly enforce uniqueness of id across array objects; the validation script must reject duplicates and preserve ID immutability.

EXAMPLES_ARRAY.title: EXAMPLES.tsv file as an array
EXAMPLES_ARRAY.description: Array schema for a complete parsed EXAMPLES.tsv file. Each item is one example row.
EXAMPLES_ARRAY.$comment: The validation script must perform duplicate-ID, cross-file reference, grammar-reference, and alignment checks.
